label: Where
value: About 5 km north-east of Manglawar village, on the left bank of the Sair Khwar
quote: is situated about five-km North East of present Manglawar village on the left bank of Sair Khwar (Sair River)
source: Wikipedia: Buddhist rock carving in Manglawar

label: The carving
value: A colossal seated Buddha, 7 m high and 5 m wide
quote: It was truly a holy place marked by a colossal rock image of Buddha, measuring 700 x 500 cm.
source: Wikipedia: Buddhist rock carving in Manglawar

label: What to see
value: Robed figure in deep contemplation, hands in the lap, folds visible on the seat
quote: The Buddha is fully robed in drapery; the graceful clinging folds of which are visible on his seat.
source: Wikipedia: Buddhist rock carving in Manglawar

label: Style
value: Compared with 7th-8th century Tang sculpture in Central Asia (a dating by style only)
quote: In style and technique the relief carving may be compared to 7th - 8th century Tang sculpture in central Asia.
source: Wikipedia: Buddhist rock carving in Manglawar

label: Damage
value: The head was hit by explosives in 2007; only the top of the head was damaged
quote: In 2007 the Taliban tried to destroy the head of the relief with explosives, although ultimately only the top part of the Buddha's head was damaged.
source: Wikipedia: Buddhist rock carving in Manglawar

label: Restoration
value: Restored by the Italian Archaeological Mission in Swat; completed October 2016, some damage left visible
quote: The restoration was completed in October 2016, deliberately leaving some of the damage visible.
source: Wikipedia: Buddhist rock carving in Manglawar
